#### What this PR does / why we need it:

- Handles the case where the subdomain is something like `-` and `prefix` is set to true in validation. 

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #101623

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
- The fix returns `-` as is and then the calling function handles passing of appropriate error message, but the function is meant to mask trailing dashes. I was a little unsure if It should return `"a"` if the name is something like `-`, i.e. a complete replacement happens and since the intent of `prefix` is to have something appended to a name, I thought this might be the right way to do it, any feedback would be great, thank you!

issue_context.title: API Server panics when GenerateName = "-"
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


#### What happened:

My controller had a bug where it was setting `myCR.GenerateName = "-"`, and the client I was using (`controller-runtime`) returned an internal server error when I tried to create it. In the API server logs, there was a panic at this line: https://github.com/kubernetes/apimachinery/blob/master/pkg/api/validation/generic.go#L74

#### What you expected to happen:

apimachinery validation logic should handle this case gracefully, and the API server should return a helpful error to the client.

#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):

Create a resource with the GenerateName field set to "-".

#### Anything else we need to know?:

This happened on Kind running locally & AKS, both ~~v1.21.0~~ v1.20.2

#### Environment:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): ~~v1.21.0~~ v1.20.2
- Cloud provider or hardware configuration: Kind/laptop, AKS
- OS (e.g: `cat /etc/os-release`): Darwin/LinuxKit (i.e. docker for macOS), AKS
- Install tools: Kind

review_comments: mask trailing dash should not make the generate name longer or it could fail length validation

This looks reasonable, given how it is used.

Please update the godoc to indicate the change in logic, and add unit tests to cover the following cases:
* `""`
* `"-"`
* `"-foo"`
* `"-foo-"`

Hey @liggitt, I just had a quick question: to mask the trailing dash, wouldn't `name[:len(name)-1]` suffice instead of the `-2`?

https://play.golang.org/p/yxWAJQgeAa9

We don't want to mask the `-` if it is also the leading character

The point of masking the suffix is that for generated names, a random alpha-numeric is appended, which would make `foo-` a valid dns name. We don't want to replace `-` with `a` if it is also the prefix, since `-`+suffix would not be a valid dns name.
Oh I get it now, thank you for the clarification 😄
